ledger: Dancer | black strappy sports bra, black leggings, hair bun, tattoos (right shoulder/upper arm, left upper-arm band), tan half-sole shoes | same attire and appearance at end | performs slow port de bras: right arm sweeps out and up overhead, lowers, repeats, finishes with right leg extended to the side in tendu

Mirror reflection of dancer | front-facing view, pose, clothing and tattoo placement matching the real dancer | still matching at end | remains pose-synchronous with the dancer in every sampled frame; no limb, clothing or reflection-geometry mismatches detected

Studio environment | wood floor, left wall with two dark doors and green EXIT signs, mirrored wall on right; barre, poster and blue bin visible only via reflection | same | handheld camera reframes slightly between 0s and 1s; a white cup appears at the mirror baseboard from ~1s onward

findings.description: At 0:00 the floor at the base of the mirror (left of the reflected dancer) is empty, but from 0:01 onward a white disposable cup sits there and remains for the rest of the clip. No person enters the frame or the mirror reflection to place it, so the prop appears unexplained; this indicates a hidden jump cut or continuity error between the first second and the remainder of the take.
